intent.rationale: ch_sel is a 3-bit input addressing five gain registers; whether values 5..7 can occur depends on the driver of the port, which this file does not show.

labels.note: 3-bit ch_sel indexes the 5-entry gain_q without a range guard, so values 5-7 read out of range.
